<script>
  
  var redeSocial = {{Click URL}}.split('.')[1]
  
  if(redeSocial == 'com/zapimoveis'){
    var redeSocial = 'twitter'
  }
  
  dataLayer.push({
    event: 'sendEvent',
    category: 'rede-zap',
    action: 'footer',
    label: redeSocial
  })

</script>

<script>

    category: 'rede-zap',
    action: 'header',
    label: btn
  })

</script>

<script>
  
  for(elm = {{Click Element}};!elm.classList.contains('ProductCard_card__LqFpo'); elm = elm.parentElement);
  
  var conteudo = elm.lastElementChild.querySelector('div:nth-child(2)').firstElementChild.innerText
  
  dataLayer.push({
    event: 'sendEvent',
    category: 'rede-zap',
    action: 'conteudo',

  })

</script>
